mapper.insert: insert into SIMULATION_ITEM( SIMULATION_ID, SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY, SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME, SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY, SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT, APPLY_START_DATE, APPLY_END_DATE, POLICY_ID, RECURRENCE_TYPE, IS_DELETED ) values ( #{simulationId}, #{simulationItemCategory}, #{simulationItemName}, #{simulationItemExpenseCategory}, #{simulationItemApplyAmount}, #{applyStartDate}, #{applyEndDate}, #{policyId}, #{recurrenceType}, false )
mapper.select: select I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, I.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME as simulationItemName, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, I.APPLY_START_DATE as applyStartDate, I.APPLY_END_DATE as applyEndDate, I.POLICY_ID as policyId, I.RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, I.IS_DELETED as isDeleted, P.POLICY_ID as p_policyId, P.POLICY_NAME as p_policyName, P.POLICY_CATEGORY as p_policyCategory, P.POLICY_MIN_AGE as p_policyMinAge, P.POLICY_MAX_AGE as p_policyMaxAge, P.POLICY_REGION as p_policyRegion, P.POLICY_SUPPORT_AMOUNT as p_policySupportAmount, P.SUPPORT_MONTH_COUNT as p_supportMonthCount, P.DUE_DATE as p_dueDate, P.REQUIRED_DOCUMENT as p_requiredDocument, P.EMPLOYMENT_PREP_STATUS as p_employmentPrepStatus, P.FAMILY_COUNT as p_familyCount, P.POLICY_STATUS as p_policyStatus, P.POLICY_URL as p_policyUrl from SIMULATION_ITEM I left join POLICY P on I.POLICY_ID = P.POLICY_ID where I.SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and I.IS_DELETED is false

select I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, I.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME as simulationItemName, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, I.APPLY_START_DATE as applyStartDate, I.APPLY_END_DATE as applyEndDate, I.RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, I.IS_DELETED as isDeleted, I.POLICY_ID as policyId, P.POLICY_ID as p_policyId, P.POLICY_NAME as p_policyName, P.POLICY_CATEGORY as p_policyCategory, P.POLICY_MIN_AGE as p_policyMinAge, P.POLICY_MAX_AGE as p_policyMaxAge, P.POLICY_REGION as p_policyRegion, P.POLICY_SUPPORT_AMOUNT as p_policySupportAmount, P.SUPPORT_MONTH_COUNT as p_supportMonthCount, P.DUE_DATE as p_dueDate, P.REQUIRED_DOCUMENT as p_requiredDocument, P.EMPLOYMENT_PREP_STATUS as p_employmentPrepStatus, P.FAMILY_COUNT as p_familyCount, P.POLICY_STATUS as p_policyStatus, P.POLICY_URL as p_policyUrl from SIMULATION_ITEM I left join POLICY P on I.POLICY_ID = P.POLICY_ID where I.SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY = #{itemCategory} and I.IS_DELETED = false order by I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY, I.APPLY_START_DATE

select I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, I.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME as simulationItemName, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, I.APPLY_START_DATE as applyStartDate, I.APPLY_END_DATE as applyEndDate, I.POLICY_ID as policyId, I.RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, I.IS_DELETED as isDeleted from SIMULATION_ITEM I where I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID = #{itemId} and I.SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and I.IS_DELETED = false

select I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, I.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME as simulationItemName, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, I.APPLY_START_DATE as applyStartDate, I.APPLY_END_DATE as applyEndDate, I.POLICY_ID as policyId, I.RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, I.IS_DELETED as isDeleted from SIMULATION_ITEM I where I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID = #{simulationItemId}
